item.title: Feeling Lucky: A Few of Our Favorite Irish Restaurants & Pubs to Enjoy this Month
item.description: If you’re feeling the siren’s song of Irish fiddles and singalongs pulling you toward good food, camaraderie, and St. Patrick celebrations, but unsure where to go, we have a list of super spots to fulfill your Emerald Isle dreams.

item.title: Join Maryland Poet Laureate Lady Brion for Two Special Events
item.description: Two Free Community Programs with Maryland Poet Laureate Lady Brion Presented by Shore Lit, BAAM, and TCFL

item.title: $3.7 M Approved for Parks and Land Conservation in Seven Maryland Counties
item.description: The Board of Public Works approved more than $3.7 million in grants from the Maryland Department of Natural Resources to local governments for parks and land conservation in seven Maryland counties.

item.title: Maryland Park Service Online Reservations System Upgraded Ahead of 2026 Camping Season
item.description: The Maryland Park Service has successfully launched its new reservations management system, which provides visitors with a faster, more intuitive way to reserve campsites, cabins, mini-cabins, pavilions, and other amenities at 37 Maryland State Parks

item.title: Women Who Shaped America: Stories Worth Reading this March
item.description: This list brings together nonfiction and fiction to honor women who shaped America in very different ways.

item.title: Visit the Bunny Cove at Annapolis Mall
item.description: Step into a world of whimsy at The Bunny Cove at Annapolis Mall, located next to Crate & Barrel from Now – April 4! This year’s Mad Hatter–themed experience transforms the mall into a colorful adventure.

item.title: Support Talbot Humane by Strutting your Mutt 2026
item.description: The Annual Oxford Day Strutt your Mutt and Blessing of the Animals for Talbot Humane returns April 25, 2026.

item.title: Harvest Bash
item.description: The evening featured Bavarian food, drink, live music by the Dan Haas Band, raffles/auction, holiday shopping, and camaraderie.

item.title: DNR Seeks Proposals for Living Shoreline Projects on Lower Eastern Shore
item.description: The Maryland Department of Natural Resources is seeking proposals for living shoreline projects on the lower Eastern Shore.

item.title: MDA Issues Box Tree Moth Quarantine in Maryland Counties
item.description: Box tree moth poses a major threat to the region’s nursery industries as it feeds primarily on boxwoods, an important ornamental shrub used in landscaping.
